From 5c968f48021a9b3faa61ac2543cfab32461c0e05 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Alexander Couzens <lynxis@fe80.eu>
Date: Tue, 17 Jul 2018 13:17:09 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] net: usb: asix: replace mii_nway_restart in resume path

mii_nway_restart is not pm aware which results in a rtnl deadlock.
Implement mii_nway_restart manual by setting BMCR_ANRESTART if
BMCR_ANENABLE is set.

To reproduce:
* plug an asix based usb network interface
* wait until the device enters PM (~5 sec)
* `ip link set eth1 up` will never return

Fixes: d9fe64e51114 ("net: asix: Add in_pm parameter")
Signed-off-by: Alexander Couzens <lynxis@fe80.eu>
Signed-off-by: David S. Miller <davem@davemloft.net>

diff --git a/drivers/net/usb/asix_devices.c b/drivers/net/usb/asix_devices.c
index 3d4f7959dabb..b1b3d8f7e67d 100644
--- a/drivers/net/usb/asix_devices.c
+++ b/drivers/net/usb/asix_devices.c
@@ -642,10 +642,12 @@ static void ax88772_restore_phy(struct usbnet *dev)
 				     priv->presvd_phy_advertise);
 
 		/* Restore BMCR */
+		if (priv->presvd_phy_bmcr & BMCR_ANENABLE)
+			priv->presvd_phy_bmcr |= BMCR_ANRESTART;
+
 		asix_mdio_write_nopm(dev->net, dev->mii.phy_id, MII_BMCR,
 				     priv->presvd_phy_bmcr);
 
-		mii_nway_restart(&dev->mii);
 		priv->presvd_phy_advertise = 0;
 		priv->presvd_phy_bmcr = 0;
 	}
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/net/usb/asix_devices.c`**
   - The function `ax88772_restore_phy` was modified to replace the call to `mii_nway_restart(&dev->mii)` with a manual implementation.
   - A conditional check was added to see if `priv->presvd_phy_bmcr` has the `BMCR_ANENABLE` flag set. If it is, the `BMCR_ANRESTART` flag is set in `priv->presvd_phy_bmcr`.
   - The line that writes the `BMCR` value to the PHY was retained, ensuring that the modified `priv->presvd_phy_bmcr` is written back.

### Relationships Between Modifications

- The modification addresses a bug related to the `mii_nway_restart` function, which is not aware of power management (PM) and can lead to a deadlock when the device is resumed from a low-power state.
- By manually setting the `BMCR_ANRESTART` flag when `BMCR_ANENABLE` is already set, the patch ensures that the necessary restart of the auto-negotiation process occurs without invoking the problematic `mii_nway_restart` function.
- This change is a direct response to the issue described in the patch, which was triggered when an ASIX-based USB network interface was put into a power management state and then resumed. The fix aims to prevent the deadlock situation that arises during this process.

Here is the commit message:
net: usb: asix: replace mii_nway_restart in resume path

mii_nway_restart is not pm aware which results in a rtnl deadlock.
Implement mii_nway_restart manual by setting BMCR_ANRESTART if
BMCR_ANENABLE is set.

To reproduce:
* plug an asix based usb network interface
* wait until the device enters PM (~5 sec)
* `ip link set eth1 up` will never return

Fixes: d9fe64e51114 ("net: asix: Add in_pm parameter")
Signed-off-by: Alexander Couzens <lynxis@fe80.eu>
Signed-off-by: David S. Miller <davem@davemloft.net>

Here is the root cause:
The bug is caused by the `mii_nway_restart` function not being power management (PM) aware, which leads to a real-time network link (rtnl) deadlock when the device is resumed from a low-power state. This occurs because the function does not handle the state transitions properly, resulting in a situation where the network interface cannot be brought up after being suspended.

Here is the patch:
 
 static void ax88772_restore_phy(struct usbnet *dev)
 {
 	struct asix_common_private *priv = dev->driver_priv;
 
 	if (priv->presvd_phy_advertise) {
 		/* Restore Advertisement control reg */
 		asix_mdio_write_nopm(dev->net, dev->mii.phy_id, MII_ADVERTISE,
 				     priv->presvd_phy_advertise);
 
 		/* Restore BMCR */
+		if (priv->presvd_phy_bmcr & BMCR_ANENABLE)
+			priv->presvd_phy_bmcr |= BMCR_ANRESTART;
+
 		asix_mdio_write_nopm(dev->net, dev->mii.phy_id, MII_BMCR,
 				     priv->presvd_phy_bmcr);
 
-		mii_nway_restart(&dev->mii);
 		priv->presvd_phy_advertise = 0;
 		priv->presvd_phy_bmcr = 0;
 	}
 }

This can lead to a real-time network link (rtnl) deadlock, preventing the network interface from being brought up after suspension.

The code statements that fix the bug are:

```c
+			priv->presvd_phy_bmcr |= BMCR_ANRESTART;
```

This code manually sets the `BMCR_ANRESTART` bit if the `BMCR_ANENABLE` bit is already set, effectively replacing the non-PM aware `mii_nway_restart` function with a PM-aware implementation.
